title: Fighting persists in Lebanon despite a ceasefire as  U.S.-Iran deal is under threat
summary: Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon on Saturday killed at least seven people, including two children, hours after reports emerged of a ceasefire agreement.
contentText:
U.S. and Iranian teams are set to hold 'technical-level' talks, according to Pakistan's foreign ministry. But fighting in Lebanon and claims over the Strait of Hormuz threaten a tentative agreement.

(Image credit: Hassan Ammar)
